name: Rongzun International Holdings Group Limited
summary: B & D Strategic Holdings Limited, an investment holding entity, functions as a specialist contractor in Hong Kong. The company primarily focuses on renovation and expansion (alteration and addition) projects, alongside civil engineering undertakings. Its extensive renovation and expansion capabilities encompass new structural constructions, interior fit-outs, facility reconfigurations, the addition of new extensions to existing buildings, and the conversion of structures for various purposes. In the realm of civil engineering, it manages site preparation and foundation construction. Furthermore, the firm offers administrative support services. Its client base predominantly includes property developers, property asset management companies, and other contractors. Established in 1995, the company's main office is situated in Kwai Chung, Hong Kong.
